system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Advantage on Persuasion when enforcing a contract or vow.

  • Once/day: compel a creature to honour a stated oath (Will save negates).
  • Your first hit each encounter with your war hammer binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Tyr in the World of Arneyan wiki.
